properties.description: **Enterprise** — Zero-trust and regulatory alignment for Batch: controls that require infrastructure investment or map directly to compliance frameworks. This tier delivers diagnostic settings streaming to Log Analytics / Event Hub / Sentinel, customer-managed keys (CMK / BYOK) for cryptographic sovereignty, and direct mapping to regulatory framework controls. Together these policies protect against lateral movement, sovereign-data exfiltration, and audit gaps in regulated workloads. Maps to NIS2 Articles…

metadata.policyName: Azure Batch account should use customer-managed keys to encrypt data
Resource logs in Batch accounts should be enabled
